description: A scrolling log of the MIDI messages a MiniLab is receiving, for working out what a controller is actually sending
notes: this module does nothing on its own: it belongs immediately to the left of a MiniLab, which passes its incoming messages across; the light at the top is on while that connection is there
the log has no jacks and no controls, and the text cannot be clicked; the first line shows the engine's sample rate, and resetting the module clears it
